# TX2 Services

> Dumpster rental, junk removal and property maintenance in Union, Missouri, serving all of Franklin County plus St. Charles County and west St. Louis County. Locally owned. Phone: (636) 584-9662. Address: 2 Kee Drive, Union, MO 63084.

TX2 rents 14-yard roll-off and trailer dumpsters (delivery, placement on protective boards, pickup, 5 days and 1 ton of disposal included), provides full-service junk removal, house/estate/hoarding cleanouts, light demolition, and property maintenance (mowing, brush clearing, lot cleanup, storm debris, rental turnovers).

## Pages

- [Dumpster Rental](https://www.tx2services.com/dumpster-rental): 14-yard roll-off & trailer specs, pricing structure, prep checklist
- [Junk Removal](https://www.tx2services.com/junk-removal): full-service hauling, cleanouts, light demolition
- [Property Maintenance](https://www.tx2services.com/property-maintenance): lawn, brush, lots, turnovers
- [Service Areas](https://www.tx2services.com/service-areas): 50+ towns across 7 Missouri counties
- [FAQ](https://www.tx2services.com/faq): sizes, weight limits, prohibited items, permits, placement
